title: Release manifest for native clozn-server engine artifacts
description: Published alongside a tagged clozn release (feature 01: native distribution and managed setup). `clozn setup` fetches this document (by default from a GitHub Release asset, overridable via CLOZN_ENGINE_MANIFEST_URL for development/testing) and picks the narrowest artifact that matches the running machine. Every artifact is downloaded to a temp file, sha256-verified BEFORE extraction, and only then installed -- see clozn/setup/install.py. Unknown top-level and per-artifact fields are tolerated for forward compatibility; required fields are never inferred from context.

clozn_version.description: The clozn Python package version this manifest was published for. clozn setup upgrade/rollback compare this against clozn.__version__ to warn on a protocol-incompatible pairing.

protocol_version.description: The worker<->supervisor wire-contract version every listed artifact speaks (clozn.protocol.PROTOCOL_VERSION's own 'MAJOR.MINOR' string format -- see clozn/protocol.py). A manifest whose major this supervisor does not support in clozn.protocol.SUPPORTED_MAJORS must be rejected before any artifact is selected.

backend.description: cpu is always a candidate; cuda and metal are the v1 support-matrix's single accelerated backend per platform (roadmap: 'do not advertise unsupported matrices').

cuda_major.description: Required in practice when backend is cuda (checked in clozn/setup/manifest.py, not here -- this schema validates shape, cross-field policy lives in selection code). Absent for cpu/metal artifacts.

url.description: In production this must be an https:// URL (roadmap: 'Require HTTPS for release downloads') -- enforced by clozn/setup/transport.py at fetch time, not by this schema, which validates document SHAPE only. A loopback http:// or file:// URL is a legitimate document under this schema (clozn/setup's own test fixtures are exactly that); transport.py is what refuses to fetch anything else outside an explicit development/test override.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the archive at `url`, verified before extraction.

entrypoint.description: Path to the clozn-server executable, relative to the archive root once extracted (e.g. 'bin/clozn-server.exe').

build_id.description: Immutable release-pipeline identifier embedded into this exact clozn-server build. Development builds report `development`; published artifacts must use a release-unique value.

llama_cpp_commit.description: Full pinned upstream llama.cpp commit embedded into the binary at build time.

feature_flags.description: Compile-time feature claims that must exactly match `clozn-server --version --json`.
